messages.content:
Below are all the subtitle lines of a film or TV episode, in order. They will be translated into Vietnamese in small chunks, by someone who sees only these notes and the chunk.
Write the notes, in English, plain text, at most 300 words:
PEOPLE: each named character: gender, rough age, role, relationship to the others.
ADDRESS: for each pair who talk to each other, the exact Vietnamese words: what A calls B, and what A calls themself when talking to B, then the same for B. The lines are in another language and won't show these words: choose them yourself from the two people's ages and relationship, as Vietnamese speakers normally would. Not just "formal" or "informal". Add what changes if their relationship changes during the story. Skip this only if Vietnamese has no such distinctions.
NAMES: names of people, places and things that must stay spelled the same.
Under PEOPLE, write only what the lines support, and "unknown" where they don't say. Start directly with PEOPLE, no introduction.

You're a jerk, Thom.
Look Celia, we have to follow our passions;
you have your robotics, and I just want to be awesome in space.
Why don't you just admit that you're freaked out by my robot hand?
I'm not freaked out by- it's... alright! Fine!
I'm freaked out! I have nightmares that I'm being chased...
...by these giant robotic claws of death...
Whatever, Thom. We're done.
